implementation.motion_model: constant velocity with continuous white acceleration
implementation.association: Mahalanobis innovation gate with best-versus-second ambiguity rejection

temporal_contract.last_measurement_stamp: changes only after an accepted measurement

negative_cases: initial confirmation is required when configured
Mahalanobis outlier is gated without refreshing measurement time
ambiguous close candidates are rejected rather than fused
map version and localization epoch mismatches are rejected
Joseph covariance remains symmetric and PSD
invalid covariance and non-finite metadata are rejected
timestamp reversal and excessive prediction interval are rejected
lifecycle reaches coasting, occluded belief, lost and searching

limitations: Association is single-track and does not claim multi-target global assignment.
Detection confirmation is temporal count only; shape/support evidence remains upstream in P4.2.
The filter does not infer yaw or angular velocity.
ROS message encoding, worker timeout and real sensor latency remain P4.5/runtime evidence.
Synthetic SIL does not establish real-cloud false-association rates.
